en: Look, I-- I just work the front.
That's all I'm supposed to do.
I don't know any more than that.
[pissed]So you are a part of this. You've been bullshitting me this whole time.
[pissed]Where's Mary? Where's the fucking Crooked Man?
Tell me what I need to know. Now!
[threatening]So help me, I will put your head through that damn door!
[pissed]I've already asked you and I don't like repeating myself. Where's the mirror shard?
I'm not part of their crew!
[hesitant]The Crooked Man's people.
{ConfusedB}Crew?
What, they just left you? What'd you do,
I--I'm not part of their crew. I don't know who... or-- or what goes on back there.
I don't know! I'm not part of their crew.
You know...
I'm not part of their crew.
[talking fast desperate]I'm telling you, they muscled in on me. Took over my storage and delivery a long time ago.

[talking fast desperate][listing, derisive]Jersey Devil... [those porkers,] Dee and Dum... [shudders]and that mental case Bloody Mary. [getting riled up]You wanna talk about the real butcher? It's her, not me. This is her place.
Victim? We'll see.
Okay, I believe you.
{ThinkingA}It's all right. I believe you. {NormalA}Calm down.
You're a liar!
{AngryB}You lied to me in the front. {ThinkingB}Why the fuck should I believe you now?
[gulps]Please...
[lost, unsure]Because it's the truth.
Shhh.
Ah, anyway...
[remembering it]They said to me, "Johann, you can keep your life and lose your shop, or lose both."
[pleading]I'm not allowed to know.
[pleading]And I don't want to know.
[pleading]I don't know what they do back there.
[pleading]I swear.
I swear.
They go in and out the back mostly.
I don't know what goes on back there.
They were gonna hang me on a hook, and leave me in the deep freeze!
So all I do is mind the front, and make it look legit.
What would you chose?
Sometimes I hand out packages in the front.
I keep my nose where it belongs.
[pleading]Please... let me go!
We shouldn't be going in there.
I'm not even supposed to look in there.
[heavy, fearful sigh]
[defensive]I told you Bigby. I don't know. They muscled me out!
[defiant, as if standing up to a bully]Where were you when they took this place from me?
[defiant, as if standing up to a bully]You come in here, making trouble for me... but you only give a shit now 'cause the Crooked Man stepped on your toes or something.
[accusatory]Well they're not here now. So I'm asking you.
Save your threats, Bigby. They sound just like theirs.
I'm in enough shit because of you coming in here today. I'm not making it worse by going back there!
Forget it, Bigby. I'm  going out the front.
Bloody Mary's gonna find me...
Hell, Bloody Mary's gonna gut me for this, anyway.
She... sees things.
I don't give a shit, butcher. Just get in there and shut up for a minute.
I should just the out of here.
Look, Johann, it's fine. Nobody's here. [stern]I want you around for this.
[unsure]Looks like they smashed it up and ran.
[angry]What happened here. What the fuck is this place?
You've seen what's here.
Let's just go back to the front and close the door...
No let's just...
Come on, let's go back.
Looks like they didn't want anyone to know what... whatever it was.
Looks like we've found something here. Don't know what it is.
[worked up]You keep saying that... I don't know what the hell you're talking about!
I need to know, and I don't want to have to ask again, is the shard back here?
Close the door...
I haven't been back here when it was like this.
[frustrated]This is going on under your nose. You can't be that dumb. You must know something.
It's something Ichabod Crane stole. [ominous]And I'm going to get it back.
Without the shard, it doesn't work.
The shard? Look around. Th
There are shards everywhere! [beat]But don't let me stop you. Have at it.
The magic mirror shard!
Didn't I tell you to sit down and shut up?
[threatening]We're gonna find out what exactly you do and don't know.
Fine, I believe you...
[sarcastic snort/laugh]What about my life?
But I need to find the Crooked Man.
But I need to find that mirror shard.
[insistent]There are lives at stake.
[weary]Didn't I tell you to shut up?
[confused]But... you keep asking me questions?
Who said I didn't report it?
Do whatever you want. [grim]You're gonna do it anyway.
[to himslef]You did what you could.
[to himself]What more could they expect of you?
[muttering, to himslef]You kept your head down.
[muttering, to himself]You kept your nose clean.
[pleading]I swear, I don't know anything more.
[resigned]I guess that's why I stuck around when they took it...
[to himself]Johann, you fool.
[regretful sigh]
Maybe just don't touch anything back here? Please?
[muttering, to himself]What more could they expect of you?
[muttering, to himself]Well, you did it.
[muttering, to himself]How many years?
[muttering, to himself]Down the toilet.
[muttering, to himself]Dead.
[muttering, to himself]You're dead, either way.
[muttering, to himself]Eh, nothing you could do.
[muttering, to himself]Screwed from the word go.
This-- this is bad, I mean... this is... [at a loss]this is not good.
I gotta... I should get out of here.
[muttering]Why you gotta do this to me?
[to himself]Why... why'd this have to happen to me?
Come here, Johann.
What are these lists, Johann? What is all this?
[menacing]Straight answers, butch.
[threatening]Or this is gonna go real bad for you.
[menacing]You wanna test me again, butcher? You wanna see how bad this gets?
[nervous]I... I dunno, it looks like some kind of... delivery schedule. The packages they run out the front. And who knows what out the back.
[defensive]How should I know? They wiped it out.
[pleading]Please... please don't hurt me again. There's nothing there.
[afraid, insistent]There's nothing there. Look! Nothing!
Is that{confusedA} a... a wheel or what?
[common knowledge][don't you know]{worriedA}{body-standB}That's the Crooked Man's... brand. It's on everything that goes in and out of here.
[testy]{thinkingB}What the hell is that?
{angryA}What's that supposed to mean?
[hesitant]{worriedA}I guess they never used that thing {nervousA}on wolves, huh?
[hesitant]{fearA}It's from back in the Homelands... {worriedA}a torture device. It came over here with the rest of our stories.
[pleading]I'm just a butcher. You wanna talk t-bones? That I can do. This stuff is outta my league.
What are they making here?
You wanna get an up-close-and-personal taste of that shit, or do you wanna tell me what this is?
No, please, Sheriff...
You can't think I'm the only one the Crooked Man has under his yoke?
[to himself as much as butcher]Chains... Who's getting chained up here?
[more to himself than the butcher]Whatever they're cooking... it looks like dirty magic.
What is this mess? What was going on here?
You better start talking, or I'm gonna put you through this whole mess.
[more to himself than the butcher]Whatever it was... [disappointed]I'm not gonna get much out of it now.
[terrified]It's just broken glass. What does it look like?
If you don't start talking, you're gonna get a real close look at this mess!
It's just... broken glass. How should I know?
[in agony, pointed]You find... you find your fucking shard?
Don't clam up on me now, butch.
[menacing] So don't test me. Now, what does this mean?
[menacing]It doesn't have to be this way, but you're making it real hard for me to play nice.
I shouldn't... I don't want to know.
[breathing heavy, struggling against Bigby's grip]Special orders... it says right there.
I don't need you to read it for me.
I know that!
Auntie Greenleaf... She's a witch.
[threatening]You wanna find out what this feels lke sticking out of your skull or do you wanna tell me what I want to know?
Little green bastard must be hard up for glamours.
[gritting teeth, struggling against Bigby]Greenleaf... I've heard that name... [ugh]overheard it. A bunch of special orders. Mary made sure the deliveries happened herself.
Like that guy, Beast said... [bargaining]there are deliveres that go in and out.
[nervous]They have a few people, I don't really know
Some Fables need to find other ways.
You think everyone can afford the witches on the 13th floor?
But I don't know what's in 'em.
[defensive]I dunno.... I'm not a damn warlock!
And when someone comes to pick up a delivery.
It's not meat, I can tell you that. It's gotta be... dirty magic.
That's what these delivereis are. They're the shit that make this town run.
Everyone in Fabletown needs something.
{thinkingB}What's it doing here?
{worriedA}{body-standB}It's a coat, {angryA}what's the big deal about some dirty...[trails off]
He won't be needing this anymore.
It looks like Crane's.
[sarcastic]I'm sure he handled it just fine.
[further examination]It's seen some abuse.
No time for travelers checks, huh?
[disdainful]Couldn't leave without a souvenir.
[pissed]That sick piece of...[stops himself]
[defiant while Bigby's back is turned]Hey! Hold on!
What the hell am I supposed to do now?
[cold]If I were you? I'd run.
I'm dead.
You leave me like this, I'm dead! Where am I supposed to go?
Thank you... thank you, Sheriff.
Report to the Business Office. Tell Snow that I sent you there and we'll... [unsure]we'll figure something out. Some kind of protection.
You're going to protect me?
[weak]I told you what I knew... and look what you did to me. You're just as fucked up as they are.
[accusatory]You really still are the Big Bad Wolf...
[hard as nails]Don't play innocent with me, butcher. You screwed with me up front. Don't cry foul 'cause you got it in the end.
I'd run.
[Shackle Him]
[stammering, terrified]Wha-- What are you doing to me? They'll kill me!
Fuck, Bigby!
I'm sure you'll talk your way out of it.
Sometimes, there's only one way to do this job. [searching for the words][feeling them out]Creative destruction. [beat]I heard that on TV.
You shoulda just stayed home...
You just go around ruining Fables' lives?
Tormenting people?
[to himself]Son of a... [begrudging]I'm sorry, okay? [beat][more genuine this time]I'm sorry.
[apologetic]I got a little hot, and...
There's no way to get out of this.
No way to cover this up.
I'm gonna have to spend the rest of my short life looking over my shoulder for Bloody Mary.
They won't care that I held up my end.
He told me he knew Mary was there. He knew where she was any time he wanted. And where the Tweedles were. Where the Crooked Man was. [derranged laugh]Hell, he even knew where you where.
He wanted to make me feel small. That's the Business Office for ya.

Crane came into the front once, hot under the collar. He was looking for Mary, demanding to see her. He was sure she was there. I didn't know, but he wasn't getting back here. So I told him I didn't know what he was talkinig about.
He was talking down that filet knife nose of his at me--
[dismissive]Shows up like fucking magic when he's looking for someone.
Shakes his head.
Knows where everybody is.
I don't know how, but he's got some way...
He said he knows where everybody is.
[to himself]Asshole.
[accusatory]i've paid the price. And then some.
[confused, growing agitated]I just don't understand...
[confused]Why are you doing this to me?
No, Crane!
Crane's gone. The Crooked Man made him disappear last night.
The shard was probably with him.
Now what the hell are you talking about?
Crane is not my boss anymore.
[ignoring Bigby's response]I can't believe I didn't-- [stops himself][rethinking][derising snort to himself]I can't believe you didn't know that Crane had his ways...
Slow down... what the hell are you talking about?
I need to know, Johann, how did Crane do it? How could Crane find him?
[stern, aggressive]Damnit, butcher, tell me how he did it!
[stern, interrupting]Hey! [slow, deliberate]How did he do it?
[indignant]Yeah...
[indignant]Go ask Crane.
[indignant]If you're so damn smart...
He's as crooked as... [stops himself]well, you know who.
[defiant]Somebody should keep tabs on him.
He keeps tabs on everyone.
How the hell do you know he had this [searching]way? Doesn't sound like you were buddies.
[unsure]Yeah.
Wait, you said "magic." Did you mean it... literally?
I don't know exactly, but...
[echoing the butcher's words]Like magic...
Get to the point!
He was spying on me?
If you're so looped in with this crew, tell me this...
After Bloody Mary snatched Crane, where would they have taken him... [refocusing on what's important]and whatever he had on him?
[thinking]I saw Mary's car drive by after I hit the warning light. If he was here, they took him and his stuff somewhere else.
Here, I guess? Or the Lucky Pawn.
Where would they take valuables?
If Crane had some magic item on him when Bloody Mary took him, where would it end up when they were done with him?
I mean, I guess that's where they'd take it.
[isn't it obvious]The Lucky Pawn.
He sure as hell wasn't using it to help the rest of us.
So I couldn't tell you what you're looking for.
Whatever it was...
He used the Magic Mirror!
Yeah, I know that magic. And I know that Crane took a shard of it with him.
[judging]Oh yeah?
I know how Crane spied on people.
[regretful]The Lucky Pawn...
[more to himself]Not if they know what this is...
If they took something from Crane... [unsure]they'd probably take it to the Lucky Pawn.
I guess that's the point of having  a magic mirror.
I probably shouldn't be surprised that prick was spying on me too.
[sarcastic]Well, I'm real happy you found what you're looking for, Bigby, but what about me?
[uninterested]Huh?
Looking for Bloody Mary.
This is just a butcher shop. There's no Mary here.
Where is the Crooked Man.
Don't play coy with me, butcher. Where's the Crooked Man? I know this is his place.
I don't know what you're talking about.
Where's the Crooked Man?
I'm just a butcher.
For a guy with nothing to hide, you still seem pretty damn worried. Don't test my patience. What the fuck is going on here?
Stop fucking around!
What do you know about Auntie Greenleaf?
Favors?
What is Bloody Mary doing back here?
[weak][to himself]Fuck...
Must be the Magic Mirror.
How do you think he did it?
That's right, the Magic Mirror!
Bigby, why don't you just use it again?
